name: The World If
look: A bright CGI render of a utopian future city with sleek glass towers, domes and curved buildings under a blue sky full of flying cars. A silver pod vehicle sits by a pool, and in the foreground a person walks a small white dog along a curving white path.
use: Imagines how advanced and perfect the world would be if one thing had gone differently. The caption reads "The world if..." followed by a wish, a missed chance or a petty change, like everyone returning shopping carts.
slots: the change that would have made the world perfect (caption above, after "The world if")
examples: The world if everyone put their shopping carts back
The world if group projects were graded separately
describe: futuristic city with flying cars and glass towers
utopian sci fi city picture for how advanced we would be
perfect future world with a guy walking his dog
imagine if everyone did this advanced city of the future
cgi skyline with hover cars and green lawn
origin: A CGI illustration of a utopian future city, captioned "the world if..." to imagine a better timeline.
